dedupe_keys.name: o2hub open data hub of the hellenic corporation of assets and participations growthfund

description: O2hub is the open collaborative data platform of the Greek sovereign holding company, the Hellenic Corporation of Assets and Participations (Growthfund), now in pilot operation. It publishes open data from major bodies in the Greek economy that the fund holds, grouped by theme: infrastructure, energy, environment, Athens public transport, networks, real estate management, public utilities, technology and postal services, with data stories, and it invites users to request datasets, propose applications and help enrich the data. Access is free through the catalogue, and no single licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: the hub is a pilot, the site is in Greek, and coverage depends on which companies publish data. Coverage is Greece. It supports multi-sector infrastructure analysis, such as energy, water, transport and network assets of state-owned companies, and capacity planning; related records are OpenCUP of Italy and the Te Waihanga pipeline.
